raw.title: (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

We're looking for a Senior Campaign Manager to own marketing campaign planning and execution across our entire D2C business. You'll be the person who spots the right seasonal moments, turns them into compelling campaign concepts, and rallies our paid, CRM, SEO, and creative teams to bring them to life - on time and on target. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct exposure to senior leadership.

What You´ll Do 

Own the Campaign Calendar 

  • Identify seasonal events, cultural moments, and product opportunities worth building campaigns around 

  • Maintain a forward-looking campaign roadmap 8–12 weeks ahead, balancing MP-specific, CYO-specific, and D2C-wide initiatives 

 

Plan Campaigns End-to-End 

  • Write clear campaign briefs covering objectives, audience, channels, messaging, KPIs, and timelines 

  • Define the channel mix and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Paid Social, CRM, On-Page, and SEO teams to align on execution 

 

Drive Production 

  • Brief creative teams on asset needs - graphics, copy, landing pages, email templates - and manage the approval process 

  • Initiate and oversee campaign-related photo shoots from concept to delivery 

 

Deliver and Measure 

  • Hold accountability for on-time, on-brief campaign delivery across all channels 

  • Track campaign performance in real-time; run post-campaign analyses and share learnings 

  • Report results and strategic recommendations with visibility regularly to the Head of Marketplace and Head of CYO 

What You´ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in campaign management or integrated marketing, ideally in e-commerce or D2C 

  • A track record of running multi-channel campaigns with real revenue impact - you can show us the numbers 

  • Solid understanding of paid search, paid social, email marketing, SEO, and on-page levers 

  • Experience managing creative production, including briefing studios or agencies 

  • Highly organized with strong project management instincts - you keep complex workstreams on track 

  • A confident communicator who is comfortable presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders 

  • Data-literate: you use performance data to make decisions, not gut feeling alone 

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience in print-on-demand, customization, fashion, or lifestyle brands 

  • Hands-on with marketing automation tools (Klaviyo, SFMC, or similar) 

  • Working knowledge of GA4 and UTM-based campaign attribution 

  • You've managed a photo shoot before  

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

Sounds Like You? 

Send us your CV and a brief note on a campaign you're particularly proud of - what made it work, and what you'd do differently. We look forward to hearing from you.

Tasks

  • Owning end-to-end product workflows, from frontend UX to backend systems, data pipelines, and edge cases

  • Building world-class frontend experiences in React and TypeScript alongside scalable, reliable backend systems

  • Designing and owning AI-enabled systems, including embeddings, retrieval, and agents that create real operational leverage

  • Developing and operating data pipelines for large-scale unstructured data

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions on architecture, tools, and frameworks to balance speed and quality

  • Deploying, running, and maintaining software in cloud environments with a “you ship it, you run it” mindset

  • Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with scalable, reusable components and APIs

  • Collaborating across the stack and raising the engineering bar through reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership

General Profile

We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in full-stack software engineering and AI, and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future. 3–5 years of experience is a plus, but we hire for skill, ownership, and output.

  • Generalist engineer with a frontend affinity, capable of building across backend, data, and AI

  • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong problem-solving ability and fast adoption of new technologies

  • Motivation to build excellent software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Willingness to work in-person in Munich with a higher intensity than a traditional 9–5 role

Technical skillset

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Solid backend engineering skills, ideally with Node.js, and experience designing APIs and data model

  • Proven track record of architecting and building production-grade software systems

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

  • AI experience is a plus, especially embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling, evals, and agentic workflows beyond prompt engineering

Leadership and communication

  • You naturally take responsibility and enjoy leading

  • You’re one of the strongest engineers in the team and make everyone else better

  • Everyone can come to you for advice on how to fix their hardest problems

  • You communicate clearly and are credible with technical stakeholders and clients

Bonus if you

  • Can share a portfolio of projects, shipped products, or a GitHub with meaningful work

  • Have experience scaling systems from early usage to larger production workloads

  • Have built workflow-heavy B2B products, internal tools, or operations software

  • You are business proficient in Chinese

Benefits

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly Wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope & travel

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

  • Meaningful compensation package including cash, performance bonus, and shares (Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations).


About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

The technical interview consists of two parts:

  • A take-home exercise, including a short presentation

  • A system design interview

For the take-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. You’ll have 2–3 hours to complete it, focusing on a real SANOVIO workflow and user flow in React and TypeScript, with a light end-to-end angle such as API integration, data modeling, edge cases, and clean architecture. Later, you’ll present your results to us.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & Reference Checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

Du analysierst die Performance von Kampagnen und Creator:innen und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungs- und Skalierungsmaßnahmen ab. As a Senior Product Manager, you will join our Technology team to drive the efficiency of Westwing's supply chain and fulfilment operations across Europe. title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Dein neues Team: Als Implementation Specialist bist du mittendrin: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Tracking-Lösungen, setzt diese um, prüfst ihre Qualität und sorgst dafür, dass aus einem Konzept ein funktionierendes Digital-Analytics-Setup wird. Du übernimmst dabei volle Verantwortung für Digital-Analytics-Implementierungen von der Anforderung bis zum Go-live und stehst unseren Kunden dabei beratend zur Seite. Das erwartet Dich: Du analysierst die Anforderungen unserer Kund*innen und übersetzt Business- und Analytics-Use-Cases in technisch saubere Tracking- und Implementierungskonzepte. Du entwickelst und dokumentierst Tracking-Konzepte, Datenmodelle und Data-Layer-Anforderungen und stimmst diese mit Kund*innen sowie Entwickler*innen ab. Du arbeitest mit Tag-Management-Systemen, implementierst Tracking-Tags und Third-Party-Tags und stellst eine skalierbare Datenerfassung sicher. Du führst technische Tests, Debugging und Data Validation durch und gehst Datenfehlern systematisch auf den Grund. Du berücksichtigst Consent Management, Datenschutz und technische Rahmenbedingungen bereits bei der Konzeption. Du arbeitest eng mit Digital Analysts, Data Engineers und Projektmanager*innen zusammen und bist die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Development. Du bringst dein Wissen aktiv in dein Team ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Standards, Best Practices und Vorgehensweisen weiter. Je nach Projekt unterstützt du auch bei Toolauswahl, Architekturentscheidungen, Migrationen und technischem Enablement unserer Kund*innen. Das bieten wir Dir: Bei FELD M arbeitest du nicht in einer klassischen Agenturstruktur mit einer starren Spezialisierung. Wir verbinden unterschiedliche Disziplinen und Perspektiven und verstehen uns als The Data Collective. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, an unterschiedlichen Kund*innen, Branchen und technologischen Setups zu arbeiten und dabei dein Wissen kontinuierlich auszubauen. Wir arbeiten bewusst toolunabhängig und verfügen gleichzeitig über langjährige Expertise und Partnerschaften unter anderem mit Google und Adobe. Unsere Projekte reichen dabei von Audits und Optimierungen bestehender Implementierungen über komplette Neuimplementierungen und Migrationen bis hin zu komplexeren Analytics- und Data-Setups. Du arbeitest außerdem nicht isoliert: Bei FELD M ist die enge Verbindung zwischen Business, Analytics und Technologie zentral. Genau diese Schnittstelle macht die Rolle besonders spannend. Und sonst? Wir glauben an People First und Sustainable Pace . Verantwortung übernehmen und hohe Qualität liefern heißt für uns nicht, dauerhaft auf der Überholspur zu sein. Wir wollen langfristig gute Arbeit leisten – gemeinsam, mit gegenseitiger Unterstützung und mit Raum für unterschiedliche Lebensentwürfe. Wir suchen Menschen, die neugierig sind, Verantwortung übernehmen und ihr Wissen einbringen. Dabei verstehen wir Stellenbeschreibungen nicht als starre Checkliste: Gemeinsam schauen wir, wie deine Erfahrungen, Interessen und Stärken zu unserer Rolle und unserem Bedarf passen. Das bringst Du mit: Du musst nicht jedes Tool kennen. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du Digital Analytics wirklich verstanden hast und dich schnell in neue Technologien und Setups einarbeiten kannst. Marketing verändert sich schneller als je zuvor.
Neue Plattformen entstehen. Zielgruppen verändern ihr Verhalten. Künstliche Intelligenz verändert Prozesse und Content. Unternehmen brauchen heute keine isolierten Maßnahmen mehr. Strategische Beratung

Creative Strategy
Du entwickelst Leitideen, Kampagnenansätze, Kommunikationskonzepte und Content-Strategien, die Marken differenzieren und langfristig funktionieren.

Ergebnisverantwortung: Sicherstellung von Qualität, messbarem Kundennutzen, Projektmargen sowie dem wirtschaftlichen Gesamterfolg. Organisationsentwicklung: Schrittweiser Aufbau von internen Strukturen, klaren Prozessen und einer leistungsorientierten Firmenkultur. Qualifikation Anforderungsprofil (Was du mitbringst) Erfahrung Praktische Erfahrung in der Einführung von KI-Lösungen in Unternehmen, idealerweise bis zur produktiven Nutzung. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung von B2B-Projekten und Projektmanagement-Methodiken. Idealerweise Führungserfahrung als Geschäftsführer, Unternehmer oder Bereichsleiter im Mittelstand. Erfahrung in der aktiven Gestaltung organisatorischer Veränderungsprozesse. Qualifikationen & Skills Tiefes Verständnis für KI-Agenten, LLM-Anwendungen, Automatisierung und sichere KI-Architekturen. Exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, um komplexe technologische Themen wirtschaftlich verständlich zu machen. Unternehmerische Persönlichkeit mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein ("Ownership"), Zielstrebigkeit und Durchsetzungsstärke. Fähigkeit, externe Spezialisten, Kunden und perspektivisch ein Team verbindlich zu führen. Echte Beteiligung & Partnership: Klar definierte Perspektive auf Unternehmensanteile (Equity) bei nachhaltigem Aufbaubeitrag. Unternehmerischer Freiraum: Volle Gestaltungsfreiheit und grüne Wiese beim Aufbau eines neuen Unternehmens ohne bürokratische Hürden. Starkes Backup & Netzwerk: Direkter Zugang zu erfahrenen Mittelstands-Gesellschaftern, bestehenden Sales-Kontakten und einem etablierten Pool an IT- und Projektmanagement-Experten. Flexibles Work-Setup: Moderne, hybride Arbeitsmodelle, hochmoderne Tool-Landschaft und freie Wahl der Arbeitsmittel. Zukunftsthema Nummer 1: Echte Pioniermöglichkeit, KI im Mittelstand produktiv zu verankern und einen sichtbaren Markteinfluss zu nehmen. Baue mit uns das nächste große KI-Unternehmen für den Mittelstand. Wir suchen keine Mitarbeiter_innen. Wir suchen Mitgründer_innen im Kopf – Menschen, die nicht nur Ideen haben, sondern liefern. Wenn du Bock hast, von Tag eins an mitzugestalten statt nur mitzulaufen, und dabei auch noch am Erfolg beteiligt zu werden: lass uns reden. Kein Anschreiben, kein Lebenslauf-Bullshit-Bingo. About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is expanding globally, and some of our largest enterprise opportunities are won through complex procurement processes. We're building the RFP Engine to own how we compete in them — a new function at the heart of how ElevenLabs pursues its most strategic deals. As a Proposal Manager, you'll be one of its founding members, owning strategic pursuits in your region from qualification through submission: decoding what evaluators actually want, shaping the response strategy with account teams, coordinating input across sales, solutions engineering, legal, and security, and driving every submission to an exceptionally high bar — on time, every time.

You'll run pursuits through an AI-first system and help make it better with every cycle. Automation handles the mechanical work — first drafts, compliance checks, content retrieval — so your judgment goes where it matters: positioning, differentiation, and quality. When you spot work being repeated, you'll help systematise it, turning what you learn on each bid into templates, content, and process the whole company benefits from.

We think the right person has lived complex enterprise bids and knows the difference between a compliant response and a winning one. You write and edit exceptionally well, you're calm and decisive coordinating many contributors against a hard deadline, and you'd rather build the machine than crank the handle.

Requirements

  • A track record managing complex enterprise RFP or bid responses end-to-end, from qualification through submission, ideally at a technology company

  • A builder's approach to AI and automation: you use AI fluently in your own work, you've shipped internal tooling or workflows (or partnered closely with engineers to do so), and you treat repeated manual effort as a design flaw

  • Exceptional writing and editing: you turn technical and commercial input from many contributors into clear, compliant, persuasive responses

  • Strong project management under deadline pressure — running contributors, review cycles, and sign-offs across functions and timezones without dropping quality

  • Commercial instincts: you can read scoring criteria, spot what will differentiate a response, and flag pursuits that aren't worth the effort

Bonus: additional languages beyond English; experience with security or compliance questionnaires; a technical or pre-sales background.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to look make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Leading regional proposals capacity as pursuit volume grows across markets

  • Specialising in bid strategy on our most strategic global pursuits

Location

We're hiring for this role in two regions. This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere in the United States (West Coast preferred) or in EMEA. If you prefer, you can work from our growing number of offices, including in San Francisco, London, Dublin, or Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Du unterstützt unser Team in Köln bei der Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme und bist die erste Anlaufstelle bei IT-Fragen. Dabei bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Wer wir sind? Seit 2007 beweisen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass Mode auch anders geht: innovativ und zeitlos, produziert nach verantwortungsvollen Standards für Mensch und Erde. Keine Lohnsklaverei, keine schädlichen Chemikalien, keine billige Massenware. Aus der einfachen Idee, T-Shirts zu bedrucken und über den Verkauf Spendengelder für Projekte und Organisationen zu sammeln, ist ein Unternehmen gewachsen, das heute zu den größten Nachhaltigeren Lifestyle Labels Europas zählt. Mit einem 190-köpfigen Team und vier Kollektionen im Jahr zeigen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass sich Verantwortung und gutes Produktdesign nicht ausschließen. Mit diesen Aufgaben trägst Du zum Erfolg bei Du wartest, aktualisierst und verwaltest unsere Hard- und Software sowie unsere Netzwerke. Du richtest Benutzerkonten, Workstations und mobile Endgeräte ein und konfigurierst sie. Du bist erste Ansprechperson im First-Level-Support für Kolleg*innen bei IT-Fragen, Fehlerbehebung und technischen Störungen. Du installierst Updates und Patches und integrierst neue Hardware, damit unsere Systeme immer auf dem neuesten Stand sind. Du pflegst und aktualisierst unsere IT-Dokumentationen und Prozesse. Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von IT-Projekten, etwa bei der Einführung neuer Tools oder bei Systemoptimierungen. Du behältst unsere IT-Systeme im Blick und erkennst Optimierungspotenziale. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Sicherheitsstandards in der IT-Infrastruktur mit. Das solltest Du mitbringen Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student*in im Bereich IT, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und kannst uns mit 20h/Woche in unserem Kölner Büro unterstützen. Du bringst idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Bereich IT-Administration oder Netzwerktechnik mit. Du hast Grundkenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie PowerShell oder Bash. Du denkst analytisch, gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an und kannst technische Sachverhalte klar kommunizieren. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und bringst Organisationstalent mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite in einem innovativen Unternehmen, das so nachhaltig wie möglich agiert und ständig neue Maßstäbe setzt. Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die auf Vertrauen basieren, und die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Teamgeist: Freue dich auf fulminante Feste mit großartigen Kolleg*innen, ein Büro mit viel Geschichte und Liebe zu Hunden, die im Büro herzlich willkommen sind. Suche verändert sich gerade grundlegender als je zuvor: AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity und autonome Shopping-Assistenten bestimmen zunehmend, wie Menschen Produkte entdecken und kaufen.

Als Senior SEO/GEO Manager (all genders) übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für unsere organische Sichtbarkeit – über klassische Suchmaschinen genauso wie über AI-gestützte Discovery-Plattformen. Du verbindest technisches SEO-Wissen mit Erfahrung in GEO, LLMs und Agentic Commerce und sorgst dafür, dass ARMEDANGELS auffindbar, verstanden und empfohlen wird, ohne dabei unsere Haltung als eines der nachhaltigeren Lifestyle Labels Europas aus dem Blick zu verlieren.


Wer wir sind?

Seit 2007 beweisen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass Mode auch anders geht: innovativ und zeitlos, produziert nach verantwortungsvollen Standards für Mensch und Erde. Keine Lohnsklaverei, keine schädlichen Chemikalien, keine billige Massenware. Aus der einfachen Idee, T-Shirts zu bedrucken und über den Verkauf Spendengelder für Projekte und Organisationen zu sammeln, ist ein Unternehmen gewachsen, das heute zu den größten nachhaltigeren Lifestyle Labels Europas zählt. Mit einem 190-köpfigen Team und vier Kollektionen im Jahr zeigen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass sich Verantwortung und gutes Produktdesign nicht ausschließen.


Mit diesen Aufgaben trägst Du zum Erfolg bei

  • Du verantwortest unsere globale S(G)EO-Strategie über klassische Suchmaschinen und AI-gestützte Discovery-Plattformen hinweg.
  • Du entwickelst Maßnahmen, die unsere Sichtbarkeit in Google Search, AI Overviews und weiteren AI-Sucherlebnissen maximieren.
  • Du optimierst Content, Seitenarchitektur und technisches SEO, damit wir sowohl von Suchmaschinen als auch von LLMs zuverlässig erfasst werden.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Agentic-Commerce-Strategie mit, damit unsere Produkte für autonome AI-Shopping-Agenten auffindbar und handlungsfähig sind.
  • Du definierst KPIs und Reportings, die Erfolg über klassische und AI-gestützte Discovery-Kanäle messbar machen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing & Product zusammen.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, E-Commerce, Digital Media, Data Science, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Technical SEO und organischem Wachstum mit, idealerweise im internationalen E-Commerce.
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung mit AI-getriebenem SEO oder Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Structured Data, Semantic Search und Information Architecture.
  • Du kennst Dich mit Agentic Commerce, AI-Shopping-Assistenten und Structured Product Data aus.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit GA4, Google Search Console und gängigen SEO-Tools.
  • Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite in einem innovativen Unternehmen, das so nachhaltig wie möglich agiert und ständig neue Maßstäbe setzt.
  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die auf Vertrauen basieren, und die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten.
  • Teamgeist: Freue dich auf fulminante Feste mit großartigen Kolleg*innen, ein Büro mit viel Geschichte und Liebe zu Hunden, die im Büro herzlich willkommen sind.
  • Benefits: 50€ Sachbezug pro Monat über guudcard, Einkaufsgutscheine bei ARMEDANGELS, tolle Mitarbeitendenrabatte, ein Jobrad oder Deutschlandticket sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Support: Unser Employee Assistant Program steht dir unabhängig vom Arbeitgeber in jeder Lebenssituation beratend zur Seite.
  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – komm einfach, wie du bist. Kleidung ist natürlich notwendig!


Ein paar Tipps zur Bewerbung

Vielfältige Interessen, Mut und Drive, die Dinge anzupacken, sind bei uns sehr willkommen.


Bewirb Dich bitte online über den Bewerbungs-Button und ergänze in Deiner Bewerbung die Infos:

  • Deine Pronomen & ggf. Wunschname
  • Deinen CV
  • Dein frühster Eintrittstermin & Deine Gehaltsvorstellung
  • Ein paar Worte dazu, warum Du richtig Lust hast bei uns zu starten.

Dann können wir uns ein richtig rundes Bild davon machen, wie gut wir zueinander passen. Das Ganze kannst Du an unsere Kollegin Milena adressieren.


Vielen Dank für Deine Zeit und Dein Interesse!

title: Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting
description: Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei? Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting unterstützt du uns dabei, dass die finanziellen Abläufe von VESTIGAS im Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig funktionieren. Du arbeitest unter anderem an Rechnungen, offenen Posten, Buchhaltungsunterlagen und der Vorbereitung unserer Abschlüsse. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Viele unserer Finance-Prozesse werden aktuell aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt. Du erhältst deshalb einen direkten Einblick darin, wie die Finance-Funktion eines wachsenden Early-Stage-Start-ups entsteht – und kannst aktiv dazu beitragen, Abläufe strukturierter, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Finance Managerin sowie unserem Steuerbüro zusammen. Zu Beginn lernst du unsere Prozesse und Systeme kennen, übernimmst operative Aufgaben und baust mit der Zeit deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich aus. Deine Aufgaben Du kontierst Eingangsrechnungen sowie Reisekosten- und Spesenabrechnungen in Moss vor und bereitest die Buchhaltungsunterlagen für unser Steuerbüro auf. title: Intern to the Chief of Staff (m/f/x) @ E-Mobility Startup
description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen EV-Besitzern einen Verkauf innerhalb von 48 Stunden und geben Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundengruppen. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, undurchsichtig und schwer vertrauenswürdig. Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die das löst, damit mehr E-Autos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Umstieg auf Elektro wirklich Fahrt aufnimmt. Und es funktioniert: Jahr für Jahr vervierfachen wir unseren Umsatz und halten bereits über 1% der Wiederverkäufe von E-Autos an Endkunden in Deutschland. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG. Ein Logenplatz dafür, wie ein Startup gebaut und geführt wird. Du bist die rechte Hand unseres Chief of Staff, Benni, der Mitarbeiter Nummer eins bei einem YC-backed Startup war und vor Aampere bei mehreren Top-Tier-VC-Startups gearbeitet hat. Du sitzt dort, wo das Unternehmen gesteuert wird, arbeitest über alle Funktionen hinweg und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab der ersten Woche. Wenn du lernen willst, wie man ein Startup von innen betreibt, von People über GTM und Finance bis Ops, gibt es kaum bessere Plätze. Deine Mission Bau die Organisation mit uns, nicht für uns. Wir verantworten die People-Funktion und skalieren gerade unseren Headcount stark, während wir die Strukturen bauen, die die nächste Welle an Hires trägt. Du sitzt mitten in diesem Aufbau und ownst echte Teile davon, statt sie von der Seite zu beobachten. Sitz dort, wo gesteuert wird. Die Chief-of-Staff-Rolle lebt zwischen den OKRs der Gründer und den Ownern, die sie liefern, und fordert und befähigt beide Seiten. Du bist in diesen Runden dabei, siehst, wie Prioritäten gesetzt und auf die Probe gestellt werden, und bildest dir dein eigenes Urteil darüber, was das Geschäft wirklich bewegt. Übernimm die Sonderprojekte end to end. Ein großer Teil der Arbeit ist Zero to One und passt noch in keine saubere Stellenbeschreibung, vom Aufbau des B2B-Angebots bis zu unseren PR- und Comms-Strukturen. Die Liste ändert sich ständig, und du bringst Themen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Arbeite im Startup-Tempo. Vieles passiert ad hoc, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und wir erwarten eine Get-things-done-Mentalität. Du bringst Struktur rein, schließt die Lücken und wartest nicht, bis man dir sagt, was zu tun ist. Das bringst du mit Du bist Generalist und denkst in Ownership. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie. Du bringst Ordnung in unübersichtliche Probleme, ohne dass man dich darum bittet, und bist am stärksten, wenn der Weg noch nicht vorgezeichnet ist. Du hast schon auf Top-Niveau geliefert. Frisch von einer Top-Universität, mit einem Track Record bei einer führenden Beratung oder einem Top-Tier-Startup. Du arbeitest über deinem Level, und das kannst du belegen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du wechselst mühelos zwischen deutschsprachiger Partner- und Kandidatenkommunikation und einem englischsprachigen Team. Du willst eine Karriere, keinen Sommerjob. Das ist ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeit-Praktikum, und wenn du herausragend bist, wollen wir dich halten. Komm mit dem Gedanken rein, wohin das führt, nicht wo es endet. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office. ...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten. ...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren. ...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt. ...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen. Why Aampere? Startup Umfeld: Jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren. Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen. Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team. Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats). Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next? EV fahren: Bald kannst du unseren Aampere-gebrandeten VW ID.Buzz fahren. Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten, direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Perspektive: Stellst du dich als Hell Yes heraus, ist eine Übernahme in eine Festanstellung nach dem Praktikum möglich. Das Praktikum ist ab sofort für 6 Monate zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams. Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung, alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht. Arbeite im Startup-Tempo. Vieles passiert ad hoc, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und wir erwarten eine Get-things-done-Mentalität. Du bringst Struktur rein, schließt die Lücken und wartest nicht, bis man dir sagt, was zu tun ist.


Das bringst du mit

Du bist Generalist und denkst in Ownership. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie. Du bringst Ordnung in unübersichtliche Probleme, ohne dass man dich darum bittet, und bist am stärksten, wenn der Weg noch nicht vorgezeichnet ist.
Du hast schon auf Top-Niveau geliefert. Frisch von einer Top-Universität, mit einem Track Record bei einer führenden Beratung oder einem Top-Tier-Startup. Du arbeitest über deinem Level, und das kannst du belegen.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du wechselst mühelos zwischen deutschsprachiger Partner- und Kandidatenkommunikation und einem englischsprachigen Team.

Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.
...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.
...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.
...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Why Aampere?

Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung, alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.
Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist.   • Has genuine curiosity about frontier model capability - you’ll actively follow what’s happening with LLMs, both in terms of their capabilities and risks, and have a view on where they’re heading

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

raw.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The role

Dex's candidate side runs on an AI agent. The client side, how companies find us, become clients, and hire through us, still runs on people and effort. It works today. As we grow, it needs a system behind it. That's what you'll build.

You'll be our first dedicated B2B GTM hire, and you'll build the system that runs the client side of the business: the sales pipeline, the CRM, the automations, the client-management engine. Your founder and team handle the relationships and the close; you’ll give them the machine that makes every one of those relationships successful.

This is a rare kind of role for someone a few years into their career: part operator, part builder, part architect of a commercial engine that doesn't exist yet.

You'll build it AI-first, the same way we build everything at Dex. Dex is an AI-native company — we build with AI, we run on AI, and the machine you build should have it in its bones.

This is a strong fit if you're a few years into your career and already the person who builds the systems everyone else works in.

We're still learning exactly where the early priorities sit, so some of this will sharpen over your first few months. The core of it stays the same: turning effort into systems.

You'll grow this role as Dex grows, and as you prove out what it needs, you'll shape what comes next.

What you'll build

The sales pipeline, operationalised

  • Own the mechanics of every deal from first conversation to signed client and live roles: stages, owners, next steps, handoffs

  • Build the qualification, follow-up and deal-support workflows — pitch materials, proposals and case studies ready before they're asked for — so nothing slips and no deal stalls for want of admin

  • Own the pipeline data — conversion by stage, deal velocity, forecasts — so the weekly numbers are trusted and decisions get faster

The CRM and client engine

  • Make the CRM the single source of truth for every company, contact, deal and role — nothing lives in anyone's head

  • Build repeatable onboarding for new clients and account-management rhythms for live ones

  • Create the plays for expansion and repeat roles, and the feedback loops that get client insight back into the product

Automation and AI, everywhere

  • Anything done twice gets a workflow. Follow-ups, onboarding steps, meeting prep, proposals, reporting — automate it

  • We're an AI company and we expect you to work like one: LLMs and agents are your default tools, not an experiment

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Every client, contact and deal lives in the CRM with a stage, an owner and a next step — the pipeline is legible at a glance

  • Every live deal has a clear next step and nothing slips — follow-ups, proposals and pitch materials go out the day they're needed, because the machine drafts them

  • New-client onboarding is a playbook measured in days, not an improvised scramble

  • The team's client-facing time goes on pitching, closing and relationships — not admin

  • We know our client-side numbers cold: conversion by stage, by channel, by segment — and where the machine needs upgrading next

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think and operate than perfect experience. You will likely be someone who:

  • Has 2–4 years operating in or around B2B revenue in an early-stage startup environment (Seed–Series B) - in growth, sales ops, revops or a founder's-associate-style role

  • Thinks in systems: you see a task done twice and itch to automate it; you build process where it helps and kill it where it doesn't

  • Is technical enough to build without waiting for permission — you can make a serious CRM do real work, wire tools together with APIs and webhooks, and turn messy data into something trustworthy; SQL fluency is a real plus

  • Has revenue or ops systems you've built before, with results you can point to

  • Is commercially sharp — you optimise for signed clients and filled roles, not pretty dashboards

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally; a lot of B2B growth is writing

  • Takes initiative, brings order to ambiguity

  • Is AI native: you already use LLMs and agents to do a week's work in a day

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

 

Practical details

  • Right to work in the UK is required

  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship

 

If the above sounds like you and you want to work at the centre of a fast-moving startup, we’d love to hear from you! Applying will take you to our careers page, where you can apply directly.


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

raw.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world's first full-stack AI doctor.

We're at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Telehealth Medical Doctor at AIOS

We're building a world-class team.

This is a part-time, sessional role — self-employed or contractor — with 5 to 10 sessions a week, flexible including evenings and weekends. You'll run synchronous 15 minute video consults, so you'll need to be online and available for the slots you book, rather than working async.

You'll report directly to Saim Dalvi, Chief Clinical Strategy Officer, and work under the clinical direction of Prof Frank Joseph, Medical Lead. We're intense, so you'll be too.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video assessment: Run 15 minute synchronous video consults to protocol for BMI 25-27 patients, starting on time as booked.

  • Documentation: Write notes that make the decision defensible and let another clinician take over the follow-up without needing to ask.

  • Independent decisions: Prescribe, redirect or decline on clinical merit.

  • Off-label governance: Hold consent conversations and produce documentation that meets GMC good practice on unlicensed and off-label prescribing.

  • Verification: Blend shared decision making with independent verification where possible.

  • Red flags: Screen for eating disorder risk, pregnancy and contraindications, and escalate within 24 hours.

  • Audit and peer review: Participate in case review and act on audit findings.

  • Feedback loop: Surface edge cases and protocol gaps to the Medical Lead and Clinical Product team.

KPIs

  • Credentialed and live: GMC, DBS, induction and ClinicOS protocol sign-off

  • On time, every time: consults held to when they're booked, zero missed appointments

  • Throughput with quality: 15 minute video consults held to time, documentation audit pass rate 95%+

  • Defensible documentation: notes robust enough that any clinician picking up the follow-up can take over without asking questions

  • Decision quality: prescriptions in the 25-27 cohort carry a documented comorbidity, an off-label rationale and recorded consent, every time

  • Escalation discipline: red flags escalated within 24 hours through the escalation pathway

Need to Have

  • Registration: Full GMC registration with licence to practise, on the GP Register, revalidation current, clean.

  • Prescribing Knowledge: Working fluency in off-label prescribing obligations (GMC Good practice in prescribing and managing medicines)

  • Telehealth Experience: Telehealth or remote consultation experience

  • Documentation: Excellent documentation skills — robust notes that make the decision defensible and easy for another clinician to pick up and take over

  • Reliability: Consults held on time as booked

  • Eligibility: UK-based with right to work, enhanced DBS

  • Availability: 5-10 sessions per week including some evenings and weekends

  • Safety Mindset: Demonstrated comfort declining a paying patient and documenting why

Nice to Have

  • GLP-1 Experience: GLP-1 prescribing experience or structured weight management exposure

  • Specialist Training: SCOPE certification or other formal obesity medicine training

  • Digital-first: Time at another leading digital-first provider

  • Governance Experience: Audit or QI leadership

  • Startup Pace: Comfortable with a protocol that iterates monthly — we're still early

🎯“You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market rate and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: £75 per hour plus equity. Paid per session, never per prescription

Benefits

  • Training: initial training provided on protocols, ClinicOS and the pathway

  • Appraisal support: audit data, case mix summary and complaints record supplied for your NHS appraisal folder

raw.title: Senior Leader - Product Marketing
raw.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

About the role

Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

We're hiring a Senior Leader of Product Marketing, reporting to the CPTO, to own the positioning, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market orchestration that makes that story credible to buyers who've heard "AI transformation" pitches before and have learned to discount them. This is a strategic leadership and launch-execution role: you're accountable for a narrative that has to survive a skeptical CTO's follow-up questions, not just land in a pitch deck.

You'll sit at the center of Product, Engineering, Sales, CS, and executive leadership — turning hard technical work into a case buyers trust, giving Sales what they need to win the deals that matter, and grounding pricing and roadmap decisions in real market evidence.

Growth today comes primarily through our sales motion — there isn't yet a significant inbound or demand-generation engine to lean on. This role needs to work effectively within that reality now, while helping shape what comes next, rather than assuming a demand-gen infrastructure that doesn't currently exist.

What you'll own

Positioning & narrative

  • Define and defend the category narrative and product positioning — including translating technical/AI capabilities into value claims that hold up under scrutiny from technical buyers, procurement, and security review, without overclaiming

  • Own messaging architecture across product lines and keep it consistent as the portfolio grows

Market & competitive intelligence

  • Run competitive intelligence (win-loss analysis, competitor tracking, technical benchmarking) and be the most credible voice in the room on what the market actually believes — evidence, not anecdote

  • Feed that signal directly into product roadmap and pricing decisions

  • Build lightweight, repeatable, automatable processes to get customer voice and insight directly into product development and launches — this currently happens ad hoc and needs an owner

GTM orchestration

  • Own launch strategy and sequencing — what to launch, when, and how big a moment to make of it — partnering with Product on roadmap-to-revenue sequencing so GTM readiness isn't an afterthought

  • Define launch success metrics and report on them credibly to executive leadership

  • Champion and put structure around the shift toward faster product launches — building quickly and iterating based on real performance

Sales & CS enablement

  • Equip Sales to win deals with best-in-class sales collateral, tools, and enablement, and support strategic deals directly where positioning or competitive dynamics are the blocker

  • Own strategic decisions on positioning, enablement, and the go-to-market motion for Sales leadership, not just content delivery

Pricing & packaging

  • Provide evidence-based input on pricing and packaging based on willingness-to-pay, competitive dynamics, and customer research, partnering with Product and Finance on monetization for new capabilities

Team & function leadership

  • Build, hire, and develop a product marketing team, and set the operating rhythm and tools for the function, including how AI is used to raise team velocity and rigor (currently a team of 4 product marketers)

  • Represent product marketing in executive/board-level conversations on market position and competitive dynamics

  • Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership without formal authority over them — comfortable creating healthy tension, pushing back, and holding a different set of priorities from those teams when it's the right call

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in product marketing, including 2+ years in people leadership, with a track record owning positioning and GTM strategy for complex technical B2B/B2B2C products — enterprise SaaS and/or AI/ML strongly preferred

  • Confident working alongside engineering and product: able to hold your own technically and translate real product/technical complexity into buyer value and revenue opportunity without a translator in the room

  • Strong quantitative instincts, with proven partnership across Product/tech, Sales, and Finance on roadmap, deal strategy, and monetisation — project-managing end-to-end what's built, what's sold, and revenue recognised

  • Executive presence: has presented market/competitive strategy to C-suite or board audiences

  • Proven experience operating at genuine scale-up pace — building processes, structure, and infrastructure from scratch with a lean team, rather than inheriting the mature systems and support functions (UXR, demand-gen, established pricing models) that exist at larger, more established organisations

  • You are an innovator and experimenter looking for new trends and technology to scale the impact and abilities of your team

  • You are comfortable with and motivated by high-expectations stakeholders; you are able to earn trust and retain it through difficult situations

  • You have a positive-sum mentality - you're equally excited about both rolling up your sleeves to get something done and reflecting on the bigger picture

  • You have high internal expectations for what is possible and the ability to bring others along on that journey

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in your own workflow (competitive research, content drafting, win-loss synthesis) — this is now a baseline expectation, not a bonus

Nice to have

  • Experience at a company that scaled through a comparable stage transition (e.g., Series B→E, or pre-IPO→public)


Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

Operations&nbsp;Quality Engineer:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Software Quality Assurance (Primary Focus):</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Define and&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;software QA processes, standards, and resolution.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Basic Qualifications:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>BSc or MEng in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.&nbsp;</li> <li>3+ years of experience in a software QA, systems engineering, or mission assurance role within a highly regulated industry (e.g. aerospace, defence, banking, medical).&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven&nbsp;track record&nbsp;of contributing to investigations and fault finding of complex systems.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) and issue tracking tools.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile and/or waterfall) and associated QA activities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Clear and concise communicator, able to We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Engineering Manager - AI Payments App
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.


What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.


Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.
